notes.title: Slip 'n Slime LAUNCHED NOW!
notes.content: [p]🎉 Slip n Slime is LIVE! 🎉[/p][p]It’s here, the full release of [b]Slip n Slime[/b] is officially available on Steam today![/p][p]Available now for Windows, Mac, Linux, and Steam Deck[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004445/95a2620414e48b4418ce8f71432d03b47732f1f3.png"][/img][/p][h3]What’s waiting for you inside:[/h3][p]🌍 A full [b]world map[/b] with [b]18 themed biomes[/b] to explore[/p][p]🎶 Tons of [b]new music[/b], with unique variants for many areas[/p][p]🖼️ [b]Beautiful unlockable artwork[/b] when you master each section[/p][p]🧩 [b]100+ handcrafted puzzle levels[/b], filled with creative mechanics[/p][p]✨ [b]Constantly evolving gameplay[/b]—new twists and surprises from start to finish[/p][p]🎮 Controller & Steam Deck support, plus cloud saves for playing anywhere[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Slip n Slime is designed to be welcoming at first, but it will test your puzzle-solving skills the further you go. With over 100 levels, evolving mechanics, and a world rich in art and music, this is the definitive slimy adventure.[/p][p][/p][h3]Thank you 💚[/h3][p]To everyone who’s followed, wishlisted, and supported along the way—you made this possible. Every bit of feedback and encouragement kept Slip n Slime moving forward.[/p][p]Now it’s time to dive in, slip around, and enjoy the adventure. We can’t wait to hear what you think and see how far you can go![/p][p][/p][p]Come join our Discord if you'd like to chat with the developers: [url="https://discord.gg/78Dw66fqBX"]https://discord.gg/78Dw66fqBX[/url][/p]

notes.title: Launching August 27th!
notes.content:
[p][b]🎉 Slip 'n Slime Launches August 27th! 🎉[/b][/p][p]The slimey challenges are almost here… Slip 'n Slime will officially release in just [b]10 days[/b] on [b]August 27th[/b]![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45004445/95a2620414e48b4418ce8f71432d03b47732f1f3.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The final version of the game is packed with content and polish, making this the biggest and best version yet:
🌍 [b]A full world map[/b] – travel across 18 biomes on your slimy adventure
🖼️ [b]Unlockable artwork[/b] – beautiful illustrations rewarded for completing every section
🎮 [b]Over 100 handcrafted puzzle levels[/b] – each with gorgeous pixel art and unique challenges
🔮 [b]Fresh interactions throughout[/b] – new mechanics and surprises from start to finish
⚔️ [b]Easy to start, hard to master[/b] – can you complete the journey and cozy up in the Wizard’s Tower?
✨ [b]A world full of music[/b] – many biomes now have their own unique song variants
🎨 [b]New animations and mechanic variants[/b] – more detail, more polish, more slime
🛠️ [b]Full Controller / Steam Deck support / Misc[/b] – controller and Steam Deck support, cloud saves, and tons of bug fixes[/p][p]Slip n Slime is designed to be welcoming at first, but it will test your puzzle-solving skills the further you go. With over 100 levels, evolving mechanics, and a world rich in art and music, this is the definitive slimy adventure.[/p][p]We can’t wait for you to play it on [b]August 27th[/b]. Add it to your wishlist, get ready, and we’ll see you in the slime![/p][p]💚 Wishlist now and join the journey![/p][p][/p][p]p.s.: iOS and Android coming September 27th![/p]
